name: aicorrection-v0.1
description: 错题强化闭环 v0.1 monorepo (R01+R02+R03 + Infra-0)

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "npm:dev:web" "npm:dev:api"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @aicorrection/web && npm run build -w @aicorrection/api
scripts.start:api: npm run build:shared && npm run start -w @aicorrection/api
